steps: Sign in and look at the first screen, which opens on the new-chat home.
If you are in a conversation, click the "New chat" button at the top of the sidebar.
Check for an empty transcript, a ready composer and the default model; the greeting and composer should be visible.

S4.02.needs: a conversation that already has messages
S4.02.note: The visible label of a conversation row is the conversation title, which is user data, so no fixed label exists in code.
steps: In the sidebar, click a past conversation title.
Check that its transcript loads in the main area.
Type a follow-up in the composer and send it; the reply should continue the same conversation.
S4.02.where: Sidebar > conversation title in the chat history list

S4.03.needs: at least one conversation containing a known word
steps: Click the "Search" item in the sidebar rail or the Search button.
Type a word that appears in one of your conversations.
Check that matching conversations are listed and that clicking one opens it.
Optionally tick "Include archived conversations" and compare the results.

S4.04.needs: a test conversation you can archive
S4.04.note: The settings nav label for this section was not found as a literal; the section heading text was used.
steps: Open Settings from the account menu.
Click the "Archived chats" section.
Check the list of archived conversations, and whether it opens, restores or deletes them.
Archive a test conversation from its menu, then restore it from this list.

S4.05.note: The pinned section appears in the project list area; the code also has a pinned state for conversations in the session list.
steps: Open the menu of a conversation in the sidebar and click "Pin".
Look for the "Pinned" heading in the sidebar.
Click the pinned conversation and check that it opens.
Click "Projects" in the sidebar rail.
Check that the projects list appears.
Click "New project" or the "+" next to the Projects heading, type a name and submit.
Check that the new project appears in the list.

S4.07.note: The description and instructions summary is not confirmed as a separate visible block on the overview.
steps: Click "Projects" in the sidebar rail, then open a project.
Check the project name and the entry points for its Chats, Artifacts, Work, Sources and Scheduled tabs.
Open "Project options" to see the project's settings.

S4.08.needs: a project that has at least one conversation
steps: Open a project from Projects.
Click the "Chats" tab.
Check that the project's conversations are listed and that clicking one opens it.
S4.08.where: Projects > open a project > Chats tab

S4.09.needs: a Pro or higher account to add project knowledge files; a small text file to upload
S4.09.note: Earlier check recorded a plan gate on upload; the exact upload control label was not found as a literal.
steps: Open a project and click the "Sources" tab.
Check the list of project files and the controls to add or remove them.
Try to add a small text file and check the result.
S4.09.where: Projects > open a project > Sources tab

S4.10.note: The visible label of the instructions field was not found as a literal in ProjectSettingsDialog.tsx.
steps: Open a project and click "Project options".
Open the project settings dialog and find the instructions field.
Edit the instructions, save, close and reopen the dialog.
Start a new chat in the project and check the instructions are applied.
S4.10.where: Projects > open a project > Project options

S4.11.needs: a second account in the same workspace
S4.11.note: The entry point to the sharing controls from the project page was not traced.
steps: Open a project you own.
Find the sharing controls for the project.
Click "Add people" and check the list of people with access.
Remove a test person and check the list updates.
S4.11.where: Projects > open a project > sharing controls > Add people

S4.12.note: The visible memory heading was not found as a literal; the aria labels in ProjectMemoryPanel.tsx were the only literal text found.
steps: Open a project and click "Project options".
Look for the project memory area in the project settings dialog.
Check the list of remembered facts for this project and the add control.
S4.12.where: Projects > open a project > Project options

S4.13.needs: a paid account that includes Work mode
S4.13.note: A dedicated Tasks page exists at the /tasks route, but no rail or menu link to it was found.
steps: On the new-chat screen, open the mode choice in the composer and pick "Work".
Type a goal in the composer.
Check that the screen is set up for an autonomous work run and that recent work is reachable.

S4.14.needs: a paid account with work tasks
S4.14.note: The Tasks page (apps/web/app/tasks/page.tsx) has filters Active, Needs you, All, Archived, but no rail, sidebar or menu link to it was found in the rail, Sidebar.tsx or the account menu; CommandPalette.tsx was searched for /tasks and gave no match.

S4.15.needs: a paid account with a work task
S4.15.note: A TaskDetailPanel exists (packages/ui/unified-chat/src/components/tasks/TaskDetailPanel.tsx), but its entry point is the same unlinked Tasks page as S4.14.

S4.16.needs: a paid account with a task waiting for approval
S4.16.note: Approve and reject controls are in ApprovalCard on the Tasks page; the Needs you filter is the closest inbox, but the page has no confirmed entry point, so the approvals inbox is unsure.

S4.17.needs: a Basic or higher account to create schedules; a test schedule
S4.17.note: The create-schedule button label was not found as a literal in SchedulesPage.tsx; creation is gated by plan.
steps: Click "Scheduled" in the sidebar rail.
Check the schedules list with cadence and status.
Click "Run now" on a schedule's menu, then "Pause" or "Resume", and check the status changes.
Open the menu and check "Delete"; read the confirmation before confirming.

S4.18.needs: a schedule with at least one run
steps: Click "Scheduled" in the sidebar rail.
Open one schedule card.
Check its prompt, cadence and next run.
Find the run history section and check its past runs.
S4.18.where: Sidebar > Scheduled > open a schedule card

S4.19.needs: a repository connected to the account for a real start
S4.19.note: The new session control label was not confirmed.
steps: Click "Code" in the sidebar switch next to "Home".
Check the list of coding sessions.
Click the new coding session action, choose a repository or runtime, and check the composer.

S4.20.note: Labels of the diff and composer areas were not checked.
steps: Click "Code" in the sidebar switch.
Open one coding session from the list.
Check the transcript, file changes or diffs, and the composer to send the next turn.
S4.20.where: Sidebar > Code > open a coding session

S4.21.note: A pair-device control was not found in LinkedDevicesPanel.tsx. The Settings section label Account was not confirmed as a literal.
steps: Open Settings from the account menu and open the Account section.
Find the linked devices list with its Last active column.
Click "Rename" on a device and save a new name.
Click the unlink action and read the confirmation before confirming.

S4.23.needs: a file to upload to Library
steps: Click "Library" in the sidebar rail.
Switch between grid and list views.
Search for a file you uploaded and check that only matching items show.
Open or download one item.

S4.24.needs: a second account that shared something with you in the same workspace
S4.24.note: The route to the workspace console from Settings was not fully traced, and the page is titled Sharing in apps/web/app/workspace/sharing/page.tsx.
steps: Open the workspace console from Settings.
Click "Sharing" in the console navigation.
Check the list of shared projects, conversations, artifacts and connectors.
Open one shared item and check it loads.

S4.25.note: The old artifacts route /chat/artifacts redirects into Library, so there is no separate gallery in the rail.
steps: Click "Library" in the sidebar rail.
Filter the list to artifacts.
Open one artifact and check it appears.

S4.26.note: The save-as-new-version rule is shown for checklist edits; the wording for other artifact types was not checked.
steps: Open an artifact in a conversation.
Click "Edit" or the "Edit document" control, or pick "Edit artifact source" from its menu.
Change the content and pause, then check the message "Checklist changes save as a new version when you pause."
Reopen the artifact and check a new version was saved.

S4.27.note: No image studio screen exists. /chat/images only redirects to Library > Images, and images are made in chat through Composer + > Create image (apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/ComposerPlusMenu.tsx). Searched apps/web and packages/ui for 'image studio': only a test that asserts the studio is not promised (apps/web/app/features/images/page.test.tsx).

S4.28.needs: an account with at least one generated or uploaded image
S4.28.note: Remix action found in packages/ui/unified-chat/src/components/library/LibraryView.tsx; the open action was not confirmed in code.
steps: Click Library in the left rail.
Click the Images tab.
Open the menu on one image and check that Download and Remix are offered.
Compare with Expected: the images are listed with open, download and remix actions.

S4.30.needs: an account that has run at least one image or video generation
S4.30.note: Expected says running, but the code shows the label Generating. Links to results were not confirmed in code.
steps: Click Library in the left rail.
Look at the Generations section at the top of the page.
Check the status words on each job: Queued, Generating, Failed, Done, Cancelled.
Compare with Expected: each image or video job shows its status and links to its result.
S4.30.where: Library > Generations (section above the file list)

S4.31.needs: a project with at least one source
S4.31.note: Code shows generated study outputs inside the Sources tab. No notes or annotation screen was found.
steps: Click Projects in the left rail.
Open a project that has sources.
Click the Sources tab.
Look for the studio outputs such as Briefing doc and Study guide, then compare with Expected (sources, notes, reading and chat over them).

S4.32.needs: a signed-in account; reports appear only after a research run
S4.32.note: The reports list lives inside the Research panel. The exact way the panel opens from the plus menu was not traced.
steps: Open a chat and click + in the composer.
Click Deep Research.
Open the Research panel and look for the reports list. An empty list shows No reports yet.
Open one report and compare with Expected: its sections and cited sources are shown.

S4.35.note: A separate /skills page also exists at apps/web/app/skills/page.tsx.
steps: Click your account at the bottom of the left rail.
Click Settings.
Under Customize, click Skills.
Compare with Expected: installed and available skills are listed, with controls to install, enable or disable, author and remove.

S4.36.needs: a signed-in account; Free accounts may see a notice instead of controls
S4.36.note: Install was traced in code; configure, update and remove were not traced.
steps: Click your account at the bottom of the left rail.
Click Settings.
Under Customize, click Plugins.
Compare with Expected: installed and available plugins are listed, with install, configure, update and remove controls.

S4.37.needs: a signed-in account; an outside account (for example GitHub) to really connect
S4.37.note: The /settings/connections link redirects to this Connectors section (apps/web/app/settings/connections/page.tsx).
steps: Click your account at the bottom of the left rail.
Click Settings.
Under Customize, click Connectors.
Compare with Expected: connected services are listed, with connect, reconnect and disconnect actions.

S4.38.note: Price is shown as a price band mark; the exact price text was not extracted.
steps: In the composer footer, click the model name.
Look at the Models list: each entry shows Context ceiling and Capabilities.
Pick a model, then open Settings > General.
Find Default model, set it, and compare with Expected: the catalog shows capabilities, context and price, and a default can be set.
S4.38.where: Composer model button > Models; then Settings > General > Default model

S4.39.needs: none; a Free account may show only a paid-plan notice
S4.39.note: Section headings were not all extracted; read the exact text on screen.
steps: Click your account at the bottom of the left rail.
Click Settings.
Click Usage.
Compare with Expected: usage against limits for each window, reset times and recent history are shown.

S4.40.needs: a paid account for renewal and invoices; a Free account shows the current plan and credit history
S4.40.note: Change-plan and cancel controls were not traced in code.
steps: Click your account at the bottom of the left rail.
Click Settings.
Click Billing.
Compare with Expected: the current plan, renewal date, payment and Invoices are shown.

S4.41.note: Profile field labels were not extracted; check the General section on screen.
steps: Click your account at the bottom of the left rail.
Click Settings, then General.
Change one field, for example Send with Enter, and close Settings.
Reopen Settings and compare with Expected: the change is kept. Then open Appearance and check Theme.

S4.42.needs: a Team or Enterprise admin account with at least two seats
S4.42.note: Members and roles are in apps/web/features/settings/sections/TeamSection.tsx; a separate /workspace/people page also exists.

Click Settings, then Workspace.
Compare with Expected: members, roles, invitations and policies are shown for an admin.
A Free account is blocked and sees a plan notice.

S4.44.note: Keyboard shortcuts are also in this menu. Support, status and docs links were confirmed in code, not opened.

Click your account again, then Send feedback. Check that the feedback dialog opens and close it.
Click Settings, then Help.
